en.headline: Two 15-year-old boys arrested after red paint poured on Mong Kok watch shop
en.dek: An off-duty officer detained the pair early Monday after seeing them splash red paint on a shop signboard and pavement near Argyle Centre.
body: Two 15-year-old boys were arrested on suspicion of criminal damage early on Monday after red paint was poured on a watch shop in Mong Kok.

An off-duty police officer walking along Sai Yeung Choi Street South near Argyle Centre Phase 1 observed the pair pouring red paint onto the exterior of the shop. The officer identified himself and detained them. The shop’s signboard, measuring about five metres long and half a metre high, was splattered, and paint also stained the pavement in front of the premises. An adjacent snack shop was also affected.
Both boys were arrested at the scene. The case is being handled by Mong Kok District’s criminal investigation team. Police are continuing enquiries into the motive.

zh.headline: 旺角鐘錶舖遭淋紅油 兩名15歲男童當場被捕
zh.dek: 休班警員今晨在西洋菜南街近旺角中心發現兩名少年向鐘錶舖淋潑紅油，即場拘捕兩人。
body: 旺角一間鐘錶舖周一凌晨遭人淋紅油，兩名15歲男童涉嫌刑事毀壞當場被捕。
一名休班警員途經西洋菜南街近旺角中心一期時，發現兩名少年正向一間鐘錶舖門外淋潑紅色油漆。該名警員隨即表明身份將兩人截停。現場所見，店舖約五米長、半米高的招牌染有紅油，門前行人路面亦被濺污，旁邊一間小食店的招牌及雜物同樣受影響。
兩名男童被拘捕，案件交由旺角警區刑事調查隊跟進，警方正調查犯案動機。
